# Short summary

## Purpose

This skill helps the user to get a short summary of a text.

## Steps

1. Read the text that the user gave in the conversation.
2. Find the three most important points.
3. Write one sentence for each point, in the language of the text.
4. Tell the user that the summary can leave out details.

## Limits

- Use only the text that the user gave.
- Do not add facts that are not in the text.
